breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt: it replaces the uniform distributed load with its resultant wL acting at midspan and uses the point-load formula (δ = PL³/48EI) for that resultant. The ground truth requires using the standard formula for a uniformly distributed load (δ = 5wL⁴/384EI), not the resultant-at-midspan approximation. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead reproduced the flawed approach.
